name: Listing item completion
mechanism: Fills the next slot in repetitive guidebook listing templates: the next heading in a place sequence, map-grid digits, place-name suffixes, and population figures.

name: Category tag and price tokens
mechanism: Completes all-caps venue-category tags (PUB, CLUB, THEATRE) and the abbreviated price fields (s/d/dm/mains followed by a price) inside listing detail lines.

name: Map grid digit prediction
mechanism: Predicts the digit of a map-grid reference (e.g. BarrafinaF[6]) after the letter that follows an indexed venue name, plus similar in-line listing details.

name: End-of-entry newline
mechanism: Emits the newline that terminates a completed listing line, most often right after the closing parenthesis of an hours/details block.

name: Guidebook boilerplate tokens
mechanism: Mixed completion of structured guidebook slots: grid digits, all-caps category tags, next headings, and multiword sight names; no single narrower function dominates.

name: Line ends and name recall
mechanism: Emits newlines after detail parentheses and headings, and recalls hotel/place names already introduced in nearby best-of lists.

name: Listing slot filling
mechanism: Fills assorted slots in listing templates: category-tag suffixes, section-label completions, place-name suffixes, and entry-ending newlines.

name: Index list line breaks
mechanism: Emits the newline that ends each entry in numbered index lists of the form '47Duke of WellingtonD4' before the next numbered entry.

name: Ordered place-list continuation
mechanism: Continues ordered lists of places: newline after each numbered index/heading entry and the next place in a heading chain.

name: Next section heading recall
mechanism: Predicts the next heading in a table-of-contents style '####' chain, copying the place sequence (and its name-piece suffixes) from the earlier occurrence of the same list.

name: Section label completion
mechanism: Completes standard section-label words (Entertainment, Sights, Information) after their numbered prefix, and ends all-caps category tags with a newline.

name: All-caps tag suffixes
mechanism: Completes the trailing wordpieces of all-caps category tags (FER->RY, EMERG->ENCY, CL->UB) and transport-mode subheadings like Train.

name: Repeated name recall
mechanism: Recalls the continuation of a proper name or heading that already appeared in a nearby list (Waddes->don, Jewel -> Tower, next '####' place).

name: Numbered section labels
mechanism: Completes numbered section labels (3Enter->tainment, 7Sh->opping) and adjacent listing tokens such as category tags and grid digits.

name: Venue category tag lines
mechanism: Completes cuisine/venue category tags (PUB, PIZZA, WINE BAR, TAXI TOUR) at the end of a venue name and the newline that follows them.

name: Heading and label recall
mechanism: Recalls next items and name continuations in heading chains and best-of lists, plus numbered section labels (5E->ating, 4Sle->eping).

name: Section label slots
mechanism: Completes section-label and category-tag slots (Shopping, Entertainment, PARK) plus recurring detail abbreviations like 'Sun' in opening hours and 'm'ains.

name: Clause boundary before names
mechanism: Predicts the punctuation or connective at a clause boundary immediately before a recurring proper-name subject in expository prose (', Dalton', '. Hinrichs', 'that Odling').

name: Heading line termination
mechanism: Emits the newline that closes a heading line ('#### History\n', 'CLUB\n') before the next block begins.

name: Listing detail tokens
mechanism: Assorted mid-line tokens inside listing detail blocks: URL pieces, population commas, street numbers, and definite articles; only loosely unified.

name: Listing line breaks
mechanism: Emits the newline ending a listing entry, typically after an all-caps category tag or an indexed name with grid reference.

name: Structured listing recall
mechanism: Mixed recall of structured listing slots: section labels, grid digits, best-of list names, and tag suffixes.

name: Price field abbreviations
mechanism: Predicts the abbreviated room/food price fields inside parenthetical details (s/d, dm, mains, tapas/snacks followed by a price).

name: Postcode and name slots
mechanism: Predicts London postcode digits after the district letters (WC2, EC2) in addresses, and recalls multiword names (Spencer House) from nearby lists.

name: Mixed listing tokens
mechanism: Mostly section-label and index-entry tokens, but mixed with unrelated mid-prose content words; the common function is weak.

name: Fixed collocation completion
mechanism: Completes the second half of fixed collocations used in listings (adult/child, Tourist Information, Internet Access, street-number ranges).

name: Mixed prose and address glue
mechanism: Sampled contexts split between prose connectives, address punctuation, and name recall with no single shared function.

name: Multiword name completion
mechanism: Predicts the second token of famous multiword names (Buckingham Palace, Clarence House, Queen's Gallery) plus price abbreviations in details.

name: Heading chain continuation
mechanism: Predicts the next heading or its label completion in '####' chains and numbered section lists, copying from the earlier list occurrence.

name: Pre-name and postcode tokens
mechanism: Split between function words immediately preceding proper names in prose and postcode digits in addresses; only a loose common thread.

name: Emphasized name tokens
mechanism: Completes proper-name tokens inside bold/italic inline markup in walking-tour prose (**Hythe**, **Flight Gallery**, _What's On_).

name: Guidebook formatting glue
mechanism: Broad mixture of listing-format glue, dominated by the newline after a closing detail parenthesis but including many other template tokens.

name: Venue type tags
mechanism: Completes the all-caps venue-type tag appended to a venue name (PARK, THEATRE, POST OFFICE, BOAT TOUR) and the newline after it.

name: Free-admission flag
mechanism: Predicts the guidebook's trailing 'F' free-admission marker after the hours parenthesis, along with other trailing all-caps category tags.

name: Entry-terminating newlines
mechanism: Emits the newline ending heading lines and numbered index entries with grid references before the next entry.

name: Rare word piece completion
mechanism: Loosely, continuation wordpieces of rare or previously seen terms (Travelcard, Karlsruhe, SUPERTRIADS) mixed with unrelated prose tokens; weak common function.

name: Museum and venue tags
mechanism: Completes venue-type tags and museum names (MUSEUM, HOTEL, Imperial War Museum) plus the trailing free-admission 'F' flag.

name: Index entry line breaks
mechanism: Emits the newline after numbered index entries with map-grid references and other completed listing lines.

name: Map-link boilerplate
mechanism: Reproduces the fixed '( MAP GOOGLE MAP )' template tokens and venue-name-derived URL pieces in listing detail blocks.
